items.title: Abandoned by our governments, people with severe ME and Long COVID are supported by severely ill peers
items.summary:
Mari, a Black Canadian woman with severe myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME), is supported by fellow people with ME in the absence of institutional care.
The post Abandoned by our governments, people with severe ME and Long COVID are supported by severely ill peers first appeared on The Sick Times.
